name: Mace of Smiting

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: +1 mace (+3 against Constructs); a 20 deals an extra 2d6 (4d6 against Constructs) and can shatter a Construct.
text: You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. The bonus increases to +3 when you use the weapon to attack a Construct. When you roll a 20 on an attack roll made with this weapon, the target takes an extra 7 Bludgeoning damage, or an extra 14 Bludgeoning damage if it's a Construct. If a Construct has 25 Hit Points or fewer after taking this damage, it is destroyed.
